feature_importance.name: has_ip_address
feature_importance.description: 1 if hostname is a raw IPv4/IPv6 address, else 0

feature_importance.name: hostname_length
feature_importance.description: Character length of the hostname

feature_importance.name: has_sensitive_keyword
feature_importance.description: 1 if path/query contains sensitive fraud keywords

feature_importance.name: num_slashes
feature_importance.description: Number of slash (/) characters in path

feature_importance.name: path_length
feature_importance.description: Character length of the pathname

feature_importance.name: num_special_chars
feature_importance.description: Total special characters count in URL

feature_importance.name: hostname_entropy
feature_importance.description: Shannon entropy (randomness) of hostname string

feature_importance.name: url_length
feature_importance.description: Total character length of the normalized URL

feature_importance.name: url_entropy
feature_importance.description: Shannon entropy of entire URL string

feature_importance.name: digit_ratio
feature_importance.description: Ratio of digits to total URL length

feature_importance.name: num_dots
feature_importance.description: Number of dot (.) characters in URL

feature_importance.name: num_path_segments
feature_importance.description: Count of directory path segments

feature_importance.name: num_digits
feature_importance.description: Total digit count in URL

feature_importance.name: num_subdomains
feature_importance.description: Count of subdomain levels

feature_importance.name: query_length
feature_importance.description: Character length of the query string

feature_importance.name: num_parameters
feature_importance.description: Count of query parameters

feature_importance.name: path_entropy
feature_importance.description: Shannon entropy of path string

feature_importance.name: special_char_ratio
feature_importance.description: Ratio of special chars to total URL length

feature_importance.name: num_at_symbols
feature_importance.description: Count of @ symbols (credential injection)

feature_importance.name: num_percent_encoded
feature_importance.description: Count of % hex-encoded character sequences
